coverage.summary: Applies to most residential rentals, including single-family homes, mobile homes and land in a mobile home park, apartment buildings and complexes, and rooming and boarding homes. Owner-occupied two- and three-family dwellings are excluded from the good-cause protections.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied two- and three-family dwellings (two or fewer rental units) are excluded from the Act's good-cause coverage. They are governed instead by the narrower N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.2(a) provisions.
coverage.other_conditions: Hotel and motel guests are covered if the occupant has no alternate residence and lives at the hotel or motel on a continual basis.
